records.scope: compiled default host web-search dependency; its image adapters are included in the crate but are not exposed by webtool's ordinary web-search interface
records.evidence: Cargo.lock checksum 7d13eab71e3c3afe4891f765d2a7ee4fd368bbd547a822c05df769803a730143; webtool-engine enables web-search by default and the candidate build log compiled this crate. The published changelog calls sogou_images.rs a port of SearXNG. Bounded comparison against pinned SearXNG revision 931fd9787b1517d88af2876175d8c31b03e11671 and historical Google comparison revision 13eec44b65d19dedddfd85755ed2adab2a22187c found matching request parameters, selectors, JSON fields, result mappings, Google Go user agent/internal API behavior, image-result fields, and image hash behavior. The corresponding SearXNG files carry SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later, while the crate manifest declares MIT. Comparison file hashes are recorded in SEARXNG-ATTRIBUTION.md; the original port revisions remain unknown.
records.missing_obligation: The published crate omitted complete MIT terms for its remainder and omitted SearXNG attribution, AGPL-3.0-or-later terms for adapted portions, changed-file identification, and source directions.
records.remedy: Bundled complete generic MIT terms and the supplied author/license statement without inventing copyright. SEARXNG-ATTRIBUTION.md identifies affected files and changed/adapted scope for version 0.3.1 dated 2026-08-07, applies AGPL-3.0-or-later to those portions, and pins the observed comparison sources and hashes without claiming unknown original port revisions. Complete AGPLv3 terms and project source-access directions accompany it.
